assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent game sprite for a Wanderer mothership module in a science fiction 4X game.
Primary request: an INDUSTRY MODULE: a compact open-roof fabrication bay, two bold robotic assembly arms, glowing orange machining cradle, finished hull plates.
Style: polished painterly 3D strategy-game asset; simple strong silhouette readable when scaled to 60 pixels. Matching modular ship construction with warm bronze frame, ivory panels, dark navy machinery and small cyan lamps.
Composition: isolated single module, three-quarter isometric view from above, centered and fully visible with 10% transparent margin, square canvas. The structure is a self-contained removable spacecraft compartment on a thick octagonal metal deck with docking connectors, clearly ship equipment rather than a planetary building. Roof cutaway may expose the functional core.
Lighting: restrained cinematic top-left light; clear material separation and broad shapes.
Constraints: true transparent background. No stars, backdrop, terrain, pedestal on soil, people, letters, words, labels, border, watermark or UI. One module only.
